card.name: End of warning-heading medical terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical term in an all-caps boxed warning or numbered section heading, such as SYNDROME, Hypersensitivity, Hyperglycemia or Neutropenia, right before the heading repeats or continues.

modes.label: Boxed warning syndrome
modes.description: The ending ROME of SYNDROME in a cytokine release syndrome warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: CYTOKINE RELEASE SYND<<ROME>> and NEUROLOGIC TOX

modes.label: Section heading endings
modes.description: The final part of a condition name in a numbered Warnings and Precautions heading.

card.plain: It fires when a long warning heading word, like syndrome or hypersensitivity, is about to be completed and then repeated.
